description: This file defines coroutine support structures, classes, and macros for asynchronous programming within the ocudu namespace, including coroutine frames, handle types, suspenders, and suspension macros.

classes.name: base_coro_frame
classes.description: Base class for coroutine frames, managing suspension state, awaiters, and coroutine lifecycle, with specializations for promise types.

classes.name: coro_frame
classes.description: Derived class that stores the coroutine function object, manages its lifecycle, and handles suspension and destruction.

classes.name: coro_handle
classes.description: Handle type for managing and resuming coroutines, with specializations for promise types.

classes.name: noop_coroutine_promise
classes.description: A promise type for a coroutine that does nothing on resume or destruction.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the coroutine from the last suspension point.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the coroutine frame, deallocating resources.

methods.name: on_return
methods.description: Handles cleanup at coroutine return point.

methods.name: get_awaiter
methods.description: Returns the awaiter object for suspension.

methods.name: await_ready
methods.description: Indicates if the awaitable is ready to proceed without suspension.

methods.name: launch_async
methods.description: Creates and launches a coroutine task, returning its future.

methods.name: noop_coroutine
methods.description: Creates a coroutine handle that does nothing on resume.
